utilities.title: Common API Response Formatter
utilities.overview: Standardized helper function across NestJS controllers to craft unified JSON response objects { status, message, data }.
notes: Ensures consistent HTTP status and envelope structure across all endpoints.

utilities.title: Centralized Error Handler
utilities.overview: Asynchronous error logger and reporter utility for catching unhandled NestJS service exceptions.
notes: Captures execution errors in service methods without crashing server process.
Stores action_type for diagnostic traceability in system logs.

utilities.title: System Audit Logger
utilities.overview: Records administrative actions (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE) with user IDs and diff snapshots.
notes: Provides audit trail compliance for admin operations on seller accounts and roles.
Compares previousData and new data payloads for change detection.

utilities.title: Object Pick Utility
utilities.overview: Filter and extract whitelist key-value pairs from request query parameters and body objects.
notes: Extracts search, status, page, and limit parameters cleanly from NestJS @Query().
Prevents prototype pollution and unwanted query parameter injection.

utilities.title: Banned Compliance Validation Engine
utilities.overview: High-performance bulk validator checking catalog items against active seller Banned ASINs, Banned Keywords, and Banned Brands.
notes: Evaluates catalog items against ASIN sets, Brand lists, and Keyword regex patterns.
Optimized for batch execution during inventory sync and feed import processes.

utilities.title: Bullet Point Array Normalizer
utilities.overview: Utility function normalizing raw string or array bullet points into clean, sanitized arrays for Amazon SP-API catalog feeds.
notes: Ensures uniform array representation of bullet points across feed generators.
Strips empty lines, leading whitespace, and invalid characters.

utilities.title: Subscription Month Anniversary Calculator
utilities.overview: Calculates exact monthly billing anniversary dates for recurring subscription quota renewals and usage window resets.
notes: Determines feature usage window reset boundaries for billing cycles.
Handles month boundary edge cases (e.g. Feb 28 -> Mar 28).

utilities.title: Standard Paginated Envelope Formatter
utilities.overview: Constructs consistent paginated response metadata containing total records, current page, page size, and total pages.
notes: Standardizes paginated controller endpoint outputs across seller and admin services.
Provides totalPages and totalResults for frontend table pagination.

utilities.title: Subscription Expiry & Grace Window Calculator
utilities.overview: Calculates UTC expiration timestamps, plan duration offsets, and grace periods for seller account subscription states.
notes: Evaluates active subscription validity during user authentication and feature access checks.
Supports trial plan expiration calculation and renewal grace period triggers.

utilities.title: Seller Usage Meter Aggregator
utilities.overview: Aggregates seller feature execution counts within active usage windows to enforce plan limits.
notes: Queries active usage records from tbl_usages collection.
Used by UsageLimitGuard to evaluate remaining feature quota.

utilities.title: GridFS Blob JSON Diff & Patch Engine
utilities.overview: Computes delta patches and applies JSON diffs on large catalog product JSON blobs stored in GridFS.
notes: Reduces storage consumption for white-label product version history in GridFS.
Enables instant version rollback without storing duplicate full-text documents.

utilities.title: White-Label Catalog Snapshot Generator
utilities.overview: Generates immutable JSON snapshots for white-label product templates and version histories.
notes: Creates versioned audit snapshots before catalog updates are committed.
Integrates with GridFS meta-blob storage schemas.

utilities.title: AI Chatbot Keyword & Semantic Match Engine
utilities.overview: Hybrid matching engine combining vector similarity and keyword search for AI support assistant query resolution.
notes: First evaluates keyword token intersections, then falls back to Gemini / Groq embeddings.
Caches resolved answers in tbl_chatbot_caches for sub-second responses.

utilities.title: Subscription Invoice & Email Builder
utilities.overview: Constructs formatted HTML invoices and transaction summaries for subscription payment confirmation emails.
notes: Renders mobile-responsive invoice HTML attached to subscription payment emails.
Supports multi-currency formatting and plan tier details.

plugins.title: Mongoose toJSON Plugin
plugins.overview: Custom Mongoose schema plugin that replaces _id with string id, removes __v and internal private fields on JSON serialization.
notes: Ensures consistent JSON document responses across Angular frontend modules.
Automatically strips Mongo internals (__v) before returning payload to clients.

plugins.title: Mongoose Paginate Plugin
plugins.overview: Generic Mongoose model pagination plugin calculating results, totalPages, page, limit, and totalResults.
notes: Used by inventory, tickets, users, banned lists, and logs services.
Executes countDocuments and query execution concurrently via Promise.all.

plugins.title: GridFS Bucket File Storage Plugin
plugins.overview: GridFS file streaming utility for uploading and retrieving large catalog CSV feeds and report snapshots.
notes: Supports memory-efficient file uploads for heavy Amazon seller inventory feeds.
Avoids local disk clutter by streaming directly into MongoDB GridFS bucket.

plugins.title: GridFS Dual-Write & Embedded Fallback Plugin
plugins.overview: Mongoose document plugin supporting dual-writing large catalog payloads to GridFS while maintaining inline document fallbacks.
notes: Ensures seamless fallback reading if GridFS connection experiences latency.
Configured via GRIDFS_DUAL_WRITE and GRIDFS_READ_PREFER_GRIDFS environment variables.

middlewares.title: JWT Authentication Guard
middlewares.overview: NestJS Passport JWT Guard verifying Authorization Bearer tokens on protected controller routes.
notes: Enforces JWT token validation on protected endpoints across seller and admin panels.
Honors @Public() decorator bypass for login, register, and public checkout routes.

middlewares.title: Route ACL Permission Guard Decorator
middlewares.overview: Custom NestJS decorator verifying seller sub-user role permissions against target API endpoint ACL rules.
notes: Enforces granular Section & Feature permissions (view, add, update, delete).
Checks permissions stored in tbl_permissions for team sub-users.

middlewares.title: Joi Validation Pipe
middlewares.overview: NestJS ArgumentPipe validating incoming HTTP @Body(), @Param(), and @Query() against Joi schemas.
notes: Strips unallowed request attributes automatically before reaching controllers.
Returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with explicit field error details if validation fails.

middlewares.title: Section Permission Guard (RBAC / ACL)
middlewares.overview: NestJS guard validating user permissions against assigned role permissions and route ACL mappings (tbl_route_acls).
notes: Reads route section permission metadata set by @RequirePermission decorator.
Queries tbl_route_acls and tbl_permissions for authorization.

middlewares.title: Feature Usage Quota Limit Guard
middlewares.overview: Pre-execution guard checking seller feature usage count against plan quota allowance before processing request.
notes: Prevents API execution if seller has exceeded monthly feature quota.
Throws 403 Forbidden with usage limit error payload if limit reached.

middlewares.title: Role-Based Access Control Guard
middlewares.overview: Guards route execution by verifying required user roles against JWT token claims.
notes: Restricts endpoints based on user role assignments (Admin, Seller, Seller User).
Executes after JwtAuthGuard validates request token.

middlewares.title: SuperAdmin Account Route Guard
middlewares.overview: Restricts system-critical admin endpoints exclusively to SuperAdmin accounts.
notes: Protects system settings, route ACL management, and cron configuration routes.
Requires user.is_super_admin flag to be true.

middlewares.title: Universal OTP Hub API Key Guard
middlewares.overview: Authenticates incoming external webhook requests to the universal OTP service via x-api-key validation.
notes: Secures universal OTP dispatch and verification endpoints.
Validates request x-api-key header against UNIVERSAL_OTP_API_KEY environment variable.

middlewares.title: Feature Usage Counter Increment Interceptor
middlewares.overview: Post-execution interceptor automatically incrementing seller feature usage counters upon successful request completion.
notes: Only increments feature meter count on successful HTTP 2xx response.
Reads feature key from @FeatureUsage() decorator metadata.

middlewares.title: Automatic Audit Log Interceptor
middlewares.overview: Captures controller request params, user context, and response payloads to persist audit entries in tbl_audit_logs.
notes: Logs admin and seller modifications for compliance auditing.
Stores old and new state snapshots for change tracking.

middlewares.title: Request Action Type Context Interceptor
middlewares.overview: Attaches action type metadata (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE) to request execution context for downstream loggers.
notes: Maps POST -> CREATE, PUT/PATCH -> UPDATE, DELETE -> DELETE.
Provides action_type context to audit and system error loggers.

middlewares.title: HTTP Request Logger Middleware
middlewares.overview: Logs HTTP request method, target URL, execution duration, and IP address for diagnostic tracing.
notes: Logs execution duration in ms for latency profiling.
Fires on res 'finish' event to capture final status code.

middlewares.title: User Session Context Injection Middleware
middlewares.overview: Extracts session token from authorization headers and injects authenticated user document into request context.
notes: Ensures controllers and guards have immediate access to req.user context.
Validates active user session state against tbl_user_sessions.

middlewares.title: Global Exception & Diagnostic Error Filter
middlewares.overview: Catch-all NestJS exception filter normalizing unhandled errors into standardized JSON error responses.
notes: Prevents unhandled runtime exceptions from exposing internal stack traces.
Logs system errors into tbl_system_errors collection.

middlewares.title: Feature Usage Metadata Decorator
middlewares.overview: Method decorator declaring the feature key and quota cost associated with a controller endpoint.
middlewares.code:
export const FeatureUsage = (featureKey: string, cost: number = 1) =>
  SetMetadata('feature_usage', { featureKey, cost });
notes: Allows granular per-route usage quota metering.

middlewares.title: Public Endpoint Exemption Decorator
middlewares.overview: Route decorator marking endpoints as publicly accessible, bypassing global JWT authentication guards.
middlewares.code:
export const IS_PUBLIC_KEY = 'isPublic';
export const Public = () => SetMetadata(IS_PUBLIC_KEY, true);
notes: Applied on auth routes (login, register, reset-password, public checkout).
Read by JwtAuthGuard to bypass token requirement.
